## What and why

## Definition of done
- [ ] Tests pass (`pytest`), architecture tests included
- [ ] No secrets, `.env`, or hardcoded URLs
- [ ] README / ONBOARDING / DECISIONS updated, or not needed (why: ...)
- [ ] Anything that changes prod has a human reviewer named in CODEOWNERS
- [ ] Status table in README still tells the truth (verified vs unverified)
